baseline_models.mechanism: The moon is made to occupy an apportioned series of lodgings: calculation governs where each visible phase belongs, so change is an ordered itinerary rather than free fluctuation.

activation_trace.role: The celestial moon and its light supply the visible body whose changing configuration is tracked.
Deliberate calculation, preparation, and setting in order supply the operation that assigns the sequence.
A منزل or منزلة supplies concrete lodgings or ranked stations, turning phases into successively occupied positions.

changed_reading.before: The moon simply changes through familiar phases.
changed_reading.after: The moon follows a deliberately calculated itinerary, with every phase placed in its own lodging.

baseline_models.mechanism: The itinerary culminates in return, not disappearance: the moon comes back as the curved, dry base left on the palm after its cluster, so terminal thinness is figured as an old structure that persists.

activation_trace.role: Return after departure and repetition after a beginning make the thin endpoint recurrent rather than final.
The dry, crooked base of a date cluster supplies both the crescent geometry and the material image of a remnant.
Oldness and elapsed time make the retained palm structure an image of temporal wear.

changed_reading.before: The waning moon merely resembles a thin old palm stalk.
changed_reading.after: Waning is a recurrent return to an old but still legible supporting remnant.

context_deltas.mechanism: The measured lodgings become a visible register: each advance leaves a persistent trace, and the old stalk-like endpoint reads as the last legible mark in an exhaustively counted sequence.

activation_trace.role: Calculation and ordering supply the focus sequence that can be read as a register.
Elapsed oldness supplies the temporal depth preserved in the final visible mark.
Advancing and going before supply forward movement whose results can remain behind.
A surviving sign of what has passed supplies the model of each phase as an enduring trace.
Exhaustive enumeration supplies the completeness of the lunar sequence rather than an approximate succession.

structural_cues: 36:12 places what is advanced, the traces left behind, and exhaustive enumeration in one compact sequence.
The focus likewise combines apportionment, successive stations, and an old residual form.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies advancement, surviving traces, exhaustive count, and measured lunar stations; I infer that successive appearances function like entries in a visible register. A live alternative is that 36:12 concerns accountable deeds without transferring its record-logic to the sky.

changed_reading.before: The stations are only places through which the moon passes.
changed_reading.after: The stations are successive visible records, with the old crescent preserving the terminal trace of a fully counted passage.

context_deltas.mechanism: The old arjun is activated as part of a productive cycle: dead ground is revived, palms grow and bear fruit, and the focus then selects the dry base left after the cluster. Lunar waning thus marks a residual phase within renewal, not sterile exhaustion.

activation_trace.role: The dry, curved base remaining on the palm supplies the focus as post-fruiting residue.
Return after departure turns that residue into a recurrent phase capable of opening another cycle.
Lifeless ground supplies an apparently spent material state from which the agricultural sequence begins.
Earth made alive through rain and vegetation supplies renewal after the spent state.
The date palm supplies the living plant to which the focus image materially belongs.
Ripe fruit supplies the productive stage whose removed cluster leaves the old arjun behind.
Vegetation emerging from earth supplies the recurring growth side of the residue-to-renewal mechanism.

structural_cues: 36:33-36 moves from dead earth to revived growth, palms, fruit, and vegetation immediately before the night-sun-moon signs.
36:39 chooses a palm cluster base rather than an abstract arc for the lunar endpoint.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies revived earth, palms, ripe fruit, vegetation, and the focus's dry palm remnant; I infer a fruiting-residue-renewal cycle that maps onto lunar waning and return. The live alternative is that the arjun contributes only visible curvature and age.

changed_reading.before: The old stalk is a static likeness for a thin crescent.
changed_reading.after: The old stalk is the residual phase of a productive cycle, making lunar diminution a reset within renewal.

context_deltas.mechanism: The moon's lodgings become time-separated orbital slots within a coordinated system: flowing motion has an assigned settlement, determination governs it, and barred catching or overtaking keeps each luminary in its own rounded course.

activation_trace.role: Calculated ordering supplies the rule that assigns each lunar slot.
Putting a thing in its proper position turns the lunar lodgings into correctly assigned places.
Flowing motion supplies continuous traversal rather than a set of disconnected appearances.
Fixity and settlement supply an assigned terminus within motion.
The repeated language of calculation extends one ordering operation across the adjacent solar and lunar signs.
Catching or reaching supplies the prohibited collision between trajectories.
The repeated celestial moon explicitly carries the focus object into the relational constraint.
Precedence and racing supply the second prohibited displacement of one timed course by another.
The celestial sphere and course of the stars supply the rounded track holding the assigned slots.
Running or swimming supplies self-consistent movement through each separate course.

structural_cues: 36:38-40 is a continuous sun-moon sequence joined by repeated determination, motion, and explicit non-overtaking constraints.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies flowing toward a settlement, repeated determination, barred catching and precedence, and swimming in a celestial course; I infer that the moon's manazil are timed slots that prevent interference. A live alternative is that the verses coordinate distinct signs without defining the lodgings as traffic-control positions.

changed_reading.before: The moon has a private sequence of phases.
changed_reading.after: Its phases are assigned orbital slots that coordinate the moon with other moving signs and prevent one course from displacing another.

context_deltas.mechanism: The consecutive shift of falak from celestial course to loaded ship activates the lunar manazil as ports on a circular voyage. The moon becomes an itinerary-bearing traveler whose phases mark arrival at successive berths.

activation_trace.role: Lodgings and stopping places supply the focus anchors that can be redescribed as ports.
Return after departure supplies completion and repetition of the voyage.
Falak as the celestial course supplies the moon's rounded route.
Swimming supplies voyage-like traversal through that route.
The same root's ship in water supplies the transport domain that recasts celestial traversal as a voyage.
Bearing a visible load supplies purposeful passage rather than mere drifting.
Riding a mount supplies the traveler relation that completes the itinerary analogy.

structural_cues: 36:40 and 36:41 place the celestial falak and the loaded ship falak in consecutive ayat, followed by created things people ride in 36:42.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a celestial falak, swimming, then a ship falak, carrying, and riding; I infer a shared voyage frame for the focus's lodgings. A live alternative is that falak polysemy only links two independent signs and does not make the moon a traveler.

changed_reading.before: The lunar stations are fixed phase positions.
changed_reading.after: They can also be heard as recurring ports on a rounded voyage, with each phase recording another arrival.

context_deltas.mechanism: The moon's easy recurring return is set against human returns that are denied, immobilized, or finally compelled. عاد therefore becomes a visible instance of governed return: recurrence is available on an assigned course, not as autonomous reversal.

activation_trace.role: Return after departure supplies the focus's regular and successful recurrence.
Being returned to an origin supplies the surah's early frame of directed return.
Denied return to destroyed generations supplies a contrast with the moon's dependable recurrence.
Inability to return to one's people supplies another limit on self-directed return.
Passing forward supplies one direction that can be blocked together with reversal.
Blocked return supplies the opposite direction, exposing movement as permission-dependent.
The final directed return supplies the enclosing destination that governs all lesser recurrences.

structural_cues: Return language appears at 36:22, 36:31, 36:50, 36:67, and 36:83, alternating directed return with explicit inability to return.
The focus moon alone performs its return as part of a measured itinerary.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated directed, denied, and blocked returns around the moon's measured return; I infer that lunar recurrence displays return under allotment rather than unrestricted reversibility. A live alternative is that the human-return passages form an eschatological thread independent of the lunar mechanics.

changed_reading.before: عاد only reports that the moon becomes crescent-shaped again.
changed_reading.after: The moon enacts a governed return, contrasting with creatures who cannot choose when or whether to reverse their course.

context_deltas.mechanism: The old curved stalk becomes an enacted process of ageing and inversion. Lengthened duration turns a formed body back upon itself, so the moon's waning curve is not only old-looking but a designed folding-back of form.

activation_trace.role: Elapsed oldness supplies the temporal condition that the later ageing statement activates.
The dry crooked stalk supplies the visibly bent result of the process.
Return after a beginning supplies the folding-back direction rather than simple forward decay.
Life extended through time supplies ageing as an accumulated temporal process.
Turning a thing onto its head supplies the reversal that converts ageing into inversion.
Measured formation supplies the body or configuration in which the inversion appears.

structural_cues: 36:68 directly joins extended age to being inverted in the created form.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies oldness, return, a bent dry form, extended age, and inversion in formation; I infer that waning dramatizes form folding back under time. A live alternative is that 36:68 concerns human senescence while the lunar simile remains purely visual.

changed_reading.before: The crescent merely looks like an object that has grown old.
changed_reading.after: Its curved thinness stages ageing as a measured inversion, a formed body folding back toward an earlier configuration.

context_deltas.mechanism: The old organic remnant is drawn into a late-surah sequence where decayed matter can be re-originated and green tree yields burning fire. The moon's dried endpoint can therefore register a reversible state boundary rather than inert depletion.

activation_trace.role: The dry organic remnant supplies the apparently exhausted material at the lunar endpoint.
Return supplies reversibility across that apparently exhausted state.
Decay and worn-away matter supply a second apparently terminal material state.
Bringing a thing into being supplies renewed origination after decay.
A living trunked tree supplies organic material capable of an unexpected conversion.
Fresh green vegetation supplies the initial state contrasted with combustion.
Burning fire supplies the opposed state latent in the green tree.
Ignition supplies the transition arrow from one material state to another.

structural_cues: 36:78-80 answers decayed bones with renewed origination and immediately gives green tree becoming usable fire.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a dry palm remnant, return, decayed matter, renewed origination, and green-tree-to-fire conversion; I infer a common logic of state change and apply it to lunar waning. A live alternative is that the late material examples answer re-creation only and do not reactivate the moon.

changed_reading.before: The old arjun marks the moon's depleted endpoint.
changed_reading.after: It can mark a threshold where an apparently spent form remains available for another ordered state.

It remains anchored in focus عاد and is reinforced by exhaustive counting at 36:12 and adjacent lunar-solar determination; downstream prose should call it a supplied morphological activation, not claim that عاد lexically derives from counting.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: عَادَ read through the packet's ع و د to ع د د split target

activation_trace.role: A counted time and recurrence at known intervals fuse return with calendrical scheduling.
A quantity brought to its fixed limit supplies the measured bounds of each recurrence.
Exhaustive counting supplies whole-surah support for treating the recurrence as enumerated.
Repeated calculation beside the focus supplies an explicit scheduling frame for celestial recurrence.

changed_reading.after: It also flickers as a counted return at known intervals, making the crescent a calendrical tick.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because gambling and deceptive victory are collateral q-m-r imagery, not the lexical sense of moon here. It remains anchored in focus القمر and is activated by the next ayah's explicit catching and racing language; downstream prose should present it only as an anti-competition resonance.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ٱلْقَمَرَ and its packet-supplied q-m-r gambling branch

activation_trace.role: Gambling and victory by deception supply a zero-sum contest model for the moon that the context can negate.
Calculated ordering supplies the noncompetitive rule replacing opportunistic victory.
Catching or reaching supplies the possible win over the moon that the ayah explicitly bars.
The repeated celestial moon keeps the odd collateral branch attached to the actual focus object.
Racing and precedence supply a second contest relation that the ordered courses refuse.

changed_reading.before: The moon is one body moving beside other bodies.
changed_reading.after: The moon participates in an ordered non-zero-sum choreography where no luminary wins by catching or outstripping another.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the frost-damaged date is a distant q-m-r branch rather than a sense of celestial القمر. It remains packet-anchored through that root and the explicit palm-fruit-arjun sequence; downstream prose should render it as a botanical echo of waning, never as a translation claim.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ٱلْقَمَرَ beside ٱلْعُرْجُونِ in a palm-and-fruit context

activation_trace.role: A date struck by cold before ripening and losing sweetness supplies an image of arrested fruitfulness within q-m-r.
The dry base left from a date cluster supplies the de-fruited form to which the moon returns.
The living date palm supplies the botanical field shared by the odd q-m-r branch and the focus simile.
Ripe fruit supplies the productive fullness against which the thin old remnant and arrested date are read.

changed_reading.before: Waning only removes visible lunar breadth.
changed_reading.after: As a contained botanical echo, waning can resemble de-fruiting or interrupted ripening before the cycle begins again.

strongest_changes: The lunar stations became coordinated orbital slots rather than isolated phases.
The old arjun became a post-fruiting remnant inside a death-renewal cycle rather than a merely geometric simile.
The moon's return became governed recurrence, contrasted with denied and compelled human returns across the surah.
The consecutive celestial-falak and ship-falak usages opened an exploratory itinerary of ports and return.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet made one compact lunar image carry several mechanisms at once: counted placement, persistent trace, agricultural residue, coordinated motion, governed return, ageing as inversion, and material state change. The strongest latent hinge was the exact palm context before the focus combined with the falak orbit-to-ship shift after it.
remaining_uncertainties: The palm sequence may license a regenerative mechanism, but the arjun comparison can still be restricted to shape, dryness, and age.
The falak orbit-to-ship hinge is textually adjacent, while the conversion of manazil into ports remains reader-supplied.
The ع و د to ع د د split and collateral q-m-r branches are packet-authorized activations but should not be promoted into ordinary derivational or lexical claims.
The late decay, origination, and green-tree-to-fire sequence may reactivate lunar state change, or may remain confined to its immediate re-creation argument.
